overview_description.description: Kiddom is an education platform offering a digital curriculum to engage students at home or in the classroom. It combines curriculum management, instruction, assessment, and communication tools into one solution to save schools valuable time, resources, and money. With the flexibility to access and edit curriculum from any location, it that can effectively support teachers and learners engaging in in-class, blended, hybrid, or distance learning scenarios, as well as in the quick pivots between them.

about_short_description.short_description: Kiddom is an education platform offering a digital curriculum to engage students virtually or in the classroom.

product.name: Kiddom Digital Learning Environment
product.description: A cloud-based K–12 platform connecting curriculum, lesson planning, instruction, assignments, assessment, grading, reporting, and student data in one system.

product.name: Kiddom Core Curriculum
product.description: A portfolio of standards-aligned K–12 digital curricula in mathematics, English language arts, science, social studies, and phonics, available with print and classroom kit materials.

product.name: Atlas by Kiddom
product.description: An instructional intelligence layer that uses curriculum, assessment, and classroom data to surface instructional challenges and guide teachers’ next instructional decisions.

product.name: Kiddom AI
product.description: A teacher-facing set of AI tools for summarizing curriculum, generating practice and scaffolds, grading open-ended work, and providing feedback aligned to instructional materials.

identifier.value: Kiddom Professional Learning and Customer Success

product.name: Kiddom Professional Learning and Customer Success
product.description: Implementation, onboarding, professional learning, training, and ongoing support services for schools and districts adopting Kiddom curricula and technology.

product.description: A digital California mathematics curriculum based on Illustrative Mathematics for grades K–8, Algebra 1, Geometry, and Algebra 2.
